ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 16 of 2020 (as amended); International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (Cap. 222, as amended, including beneficial ownership obligations imposed on registered agents); Companies Act No. 19 of 2016 (as amended); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 43 of 2015 (empowering the VFSC to operate a confidential central beneficial ownership register); Financial Dealers Act No. 26 of 2020; Proceeds of Crime Act (Cap. 276); Counter-Terrorism and Transnational Organized Crime Act; VFSC AML/CFT Rules and Guidance Notes aligned with the revised FATF Recommendations. Registered agents must file UBO particulars with the VFSC within statutory timeframes and maintain source-of-funds and source-of-wealth records.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based screening of every UBO, director, shareholder, authorized signatory, and underlying beneficiary against the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU) PEP database, the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Lists, UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, EU autonomous sanctions list, and the Vanuatu domestic sanctions register administered by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) is statutorily triggered for foreign and domestic PEPs, high-risk geographical exposure, transactions from jurisdictions under FATF increased monitoring, and medium-risk medical-device export flows involving public-hospital procurement and government tenders. All screening results, negative news searches, and adverse-media findings must be documented in the mandatory Client Due Diligence file under Section 14 of the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 16 of 2020; any match or suspicious transaction must be reported to the VFIU without delay, and records retained for not less than five years after business relationship termination.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Companies Registry — Official Online Name Reservation and E-Services Portal (www.vfsc.vu); name search and reservation are effected by a VFSC-licensed registered agent through the Companies Online System.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory filings are accepted in English (French is recognized at the statutory level, but English is the operative registry language). The registered corporate name must be rendered exclusively in Latin-script English or French characters; non-Latin scripts, including Chinese characters, are not permitted in the statutory corporate name. Any foreign-language commercial alias must be a romanized transliteration and may only be used in marketing materials if clearly secondary to the registered Latin-script name. The name must be distinguishable from all existing reserved or registered names, must not be misleading as to the company's activities, and must end with the limited-liability designator 'Limited' or the accepted abbreviation 'Ltd.'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a rejection notice issued by the VFSC International Companies Registry, the applicant, acting exclusively through its licensed registered agent, may file a formal Request for Review with the VFSC Registry Secretariat within 14 days of the rejection date. The request must include legal submissions, corrected alternative names, or a supporting instrument evidencing prior ministerial or sectoral authorization for any sensitive token. The VFSC is required to issue its review determination within 21 business days. A name reservation may be extended for successive 30-day periods upon payment of the statutory extension fee and certification by the registered agent that incorporation proceedings are actively in progress. A final refusal may be challenged by way of judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu, and thereafter under the appellate jurisdiction of the Vanuatu Court of Appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A pure virtual office comprising only mail-forwarding is not permissible. Every International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Vanuatu and a VFSC-licensed registered agent at all times; the registered agent's physical office, open during statutory business hours and capable of receiving service of process, satisfies the registered-office mandate. For the ISIC 3250 titanium orthopedic implant manufacturing activity, offshore production, warehousing, and electron-beam 3D melting facilities are permitted without local plant presence, provided the registered agent retains the statutory registers, UBO files, and AML/CFT records in Vanuatu.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for a passive, non-licensed International Company: approximately 3% annual probability of an unannounced physical inspection of the registered office. The probability increases to 12-18% per annum where a PEP is identified as a beneficial owner, where funds originate from jurisdictions under FATF increased monitoring, or where the registered agent's UBO record is flagged incomplete by the VFIU. Medical-device export transactions are primarily subject to documentary and transaction review by the VFSC and VFIU, rather than routine on-site industrial inspection, but sanctions or adverse-media matches will materially elevate the physical inspection risk.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 [Cap. 222], ss. 4-9 (Incorporation and Articles of Incorporation), ss. 13-16 (Registered Office, Registered Agent and Filing), ss. 20-24 (Share Capital and No Par Value Shares)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry Division, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (registered under the VFSC International Companies Regulations)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; at least one share of no par value is required, the corporate capital may be denominated in any currency, and no escrow or up-front payment deposit is mandated; a paid-up capital of USD 1 or its equivalent satisfies the rule.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the subscribers to the Articles of Incorporation are hereby confirmed as the founding shareholders of the Company, and the allotment of 1,000 ordinary shares of no par value is ratified. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the registered office of the Company be established at the office of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT [Director A] is appointed Managing Director and [Director B] is appointed Finance Director, each to serve until the next annual general meeting. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the corporate bank mandates, signing authorities, and registered agent engagement are approved, and the Managing Director is authorized to execute all formation filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Search, Reservation and Registered Agent Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry via a licensed Vanuatu registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name search and reservation request through a licensed VFSC agent for a 30-day priority period; concurrently execute the registered agent engagement letter and consent form, confirming the Port Vila registered office address.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copies of subscribers and proposed directors
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement)
Registered agent consent and appointment letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the preferred name is unavailable or flagged, the agent automatically re-submits up to two substitute names within 24 hours at no additional government fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Notarization and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Notary Public in conjunction with the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation reflecting the titanium orthopedic implant manufacturing object, share classes, director indemnity and optional memorandum of continuity; have subscriber signatures notarized and obtain the registered agent's consent to act; verify that the paid-up capital statement and registered office clause comply with Cap. 222.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney authorizing the agent to lodge the filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries a drafting irregularity, the board executes corrective articles by written consent and the agent re-lodges within 5 business days without a fresh government fee for the first correction.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Lodgment of Incorporation Application with VFSC and Fee Payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Corporate Registry, Port Vila (online or in-person counters)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge the executed Articles of Incorporation together with the statutory filing cover letter and subscriber due diligence forms; pay the official incorporation fee of approximately USD 350 via bank transfer or VFSC cashier; obtain the Certificate of Incorporation upon successful registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any VFSC registry query within 30 calendar days with correcting documents; a first-time correction is processed without additional official fees, and an express 48-hour review may be requested on urgent grounds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Corporate Governance Records and Share Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent / company secretary under VFSC supervision
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the first board resolution, allot shares to founding subscribers, issue share certificates, open the statutory registers of members, directors and charges, procure the company seal and minute book, and file the register of directors with the registered agent for inspection.
required_dossiers: Register of members and register of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defective records are rectified by a written board resolution and re-issuance of share certificates; late filing corrections are accepted with an explanatory letter and, where necessary, a late filing penalty assessment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening, Foreign Investment Certificate and Operating License Kick-off
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu commercial banks (ANZ, BSP) and the Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate account for SWIFT wire and letter of credit transactions using the incorporation pack; apply to VIPA for a Foreign Investment Certificate for the physical manufacturing plant; complete enhanced KYCC and beneficial ownership disclosure consistent with the Medium-Risk Enhanced AML tier; begin medical device establishment licensing procedures.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Articles of Incorporation
VIPA application form with business plan and projected cash flows
Bank KYCC and beneficial ownership declaration forms
Factory site land lease or host agreement
Directors' resumes for the fit-and-proper assessment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank declines the account or VIPA queries the application, the applicant may submit enhanced due diligence explanations, nominate an alternate director, apply to a second licensed bank, or request VIPA's internal review within 14 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and the Ministry of Health, Pharmacy and Medicines Regulation Section
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Foreign Investment Certificate (VIPA) and Medical Device Manufacturing Establishment Licence (class III implantable devices)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B (Manufacturing and Industrial Development) - Preliminary Environmental Impact Assessment and an Environmental Management Plan are mandatory; a full Environmental Impact Assessment Report is triggered if the facility sits within 200 meters of coastal waters, groundwater, or a residential zone.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater effluent must not exceed pH 6.5-8.5, BOD below 30 mg/L and TSS below 50 mg/L before discharge to municipal systems or land; air emissions must control titanium particulates below 50 ug/m3 ambient PM10 and eliminate ozone-depleting substances; argon, titanium dust and electron-beam process residuals are managed under the National Waste Management Act hazardous waste manifesting rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services (VFES) prior to occupancy; building structural clearance under the Vanuatu Building Code 2011; occupational health and safety registration with the Department of Labour including radiation and electron-beam equipment protection assessments, argon gas storage inspection, and workplace ergonomic and ventilation sign-off for the machining and 3D melting operation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management — portal www.dcir.gov.vu; International Company registry and exemption administration: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — portal www.vfsc.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: No TIN or VAT ID exists for an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; Vanuatu levies no direct tax. SOP: (1) appoint a VFSC-licensed registered agent; (2) file Articles of Incorporation and pay the VFSC registration fee; (3) obtain the Certificate of Incorporation (unique IC number); (4) receive the statutory exemption under s.205, evidenced by a Certificate of Tax Exemption; (5) file annual agent returns and pay the annual government fee (no tax return); (6) register with Vanuatu Customs (ASYCUDA) only if physical goods are exported from Vanuatu in a licensed capacity. Non-resident ownership is permitted and requires no local tax registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The IC is automatically and exclusively tax-exempt; there are no check-the-box, hybrid mismatch, or residency elections in Vanuatu law, and an IC cannot elect to be taxable or resident in Vanuatu.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST. Vanuatu's indirect regime consists of customs and excise duties (Customs and Excise Act [Cap 249]) and stamp duties (Stamp Duties Act [Cap 75]); no value-added or general sales tax is legislated.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable (VUV 0 threshold): no VAT/GST exists and therefore no turnover threshold triggers indirect tax registration. Commercial importers/exporters of physical goods must obtain a Customs registration in ASYCUDA; the IC's extraterritorial operations fall outside the domestic indirect tax net.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Vanuatu imposes no e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping, or tax-API mandate. Customs declarations are submitted electronically through the ASYCUDA World single window; no digital invoice clearance applies to International Companies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no VAT/GST and thus no export zero-rating or input-VAT refund mechanism. Exports from Vanuatu are duty-free under the Customs and Excise Act upon a valid ASYCUDA export declaration. The IC's offshore design, production, and trading income is extraterritorial and exempt; no zero-rating claim is required or available. Vanuatu imposes no exchange controls; the 180-day benchmark below reflects bank/letter-of-credit practice rather than a statutory repatriation deadline. Physical manufacture inside Vanuatu (rather than offshore or subcontracted production) would require an IC business license and attract domestic customs/duty treatment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Certificate of Origin (if required by the importing jurisdiction)
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank FX credit evidence
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT zero-rating clawback is possible (no VAT). Penalties instead arise under the Customs and Excise Act [Cap 249] for false export declarations: forfeiture of goods, fines up to VUV 1,000,000 or three times the duty value, imprisonment on conviction, and retrospective duty and interest assessments by DCIR. VFSC may fine, strike off, or deregister an IC and revoke its tax exemption for acting in breach of the International Companies Act (e.g., unauthorized domestic business), and misrepresentation to the registered agent constitutes an offence under s.230 with separate penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vanuatu vatu (VUV) is floating and fully convertible across current and capital account transactions. Vanuatu has accepted IMF Article VIII obligations, confirming the absence of restrictions on international current payments and transfers. No prior exchange-control approval is required for inbound equity capital, trade settlements, or profit and dividend repatriation; however, the underlying commercial purpose and source of funds must be documented to satisfy bank-level AML/CFT due diligence. Official reserve management and statistics reporting may require the bank to tag a narrative purpose code but do not constitute conversion controls.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion obligations. Exporters and trading companies may retain receipts in any permitted currency or operating account, with no regulatory timeline for conversion, repatriation, or closure into VUV. The only operational requirement is accurate transaction record-keeping in the bank's AML/CFT systems, including the invoice, bill of lading, and letter of credit reference, to substantiate the underlying export of titanium orthopedic implant products.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: Medium. Vanuatu does not currently grant dedicated electronic-money institution (EMI) licenses to offshore fintech providers; however, foreign-regulated EMIs may onboard a Vanuatu International Company if they comply with the Registration of International Companies Act, the AML/CFT Act, and VFSC supervision concerning money or value transfer services. Offshore digital EMIs are viable only for low-value receivables collection and non-critical settlement channels; they cannot be used as primary treasury conduits for capital escrow, documentary credits, or substantial trade disbursements due to lacking prudential and correspondent banking depth.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory mandate obliges directors to appear physically at a Vanuatu bank branch. Remote account opening is permissible for non-resident International Companies under a non-face-to-face KYC framework, provided the bank receives certified constitutional documents, a registered agent certificate, director identification, beneficial ownership declarations, and acceptable source-of-funds evidence. In practice, a video-call verification with the compliance officer is required, and where new signatories are not previously known to the bank, an in-person interview at the Port Vila office or a notarized attestation at a Vanuatu diplomatic mission may be requested for the capital escrow account onboarding.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Ownership opacity where the International Company uses nominee shareholders or lacks a direct natural-person owner.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit (a) the register of members, (b) register of directors, (c) an ultimate beneficial ownership declaration under the International Companies Act, (d) certified copies of passports and proof of residence of all natural-person owners, (e) the registered agent's certificate of good standing, (f) a trust deed or nominee declaration if applicable, and (g) bank reference letters from the shareholders' home institutions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payment flows from, to, or routed through jurisdictions listed on FATF grey lists, UN sanctions, or OFAC/ECOFIN restrictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver (a) full commercial contract with clear Incoterms 2020, (b) proforma invoices and purchase orders, (c) end-user certificates issued by hospitals or distributors for orthopedic implants, (d) transport evidence such as airway bills and bills of lading, (e) certificates of conformity including ISO 13485 and CE marking, and (f) a legal opinion from a Vanuatu-licensed attorney screening all counterparties and correspondents against applicable sanctions lists.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid layering or immediate outward transfer of injected capital before any visible manufacturing or trade activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide (a) the board resolution authorizing the treasury and escrow structure, (b) a 12-month cash-flow forecast linked to the electron-beam 3D printing facility, (c) the share subscription schedule and certificate of shares issued, (d) a source-of-wealth declaration supported by audited financial statements of the contributing shareholder, and (e) executed master supply agreements with the titanium powder vendors and equipment OEMs.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use SWIFT MT103 with narrative reference stating 'Equity injection for International Company VU_IC_ISIC3250_04_TITANIUM_ORTHOPEDIC_IMPLANT' and the subscription invoice number. For amounts above USD 5 million or the bank's internal threshold, execute the transfer via MT103 with an MT202 cover instruction and SWIFT GPI tracking. The beneficiary bank will conduct a source-of-funds check; retain the share allotment resolution, board minute on escrow account usage, and evidence of the subscription project financing arrangement. Purpose code fields do not follow national standards in Vanuatu, so the narrative must unambiguously classify the transfer as 'Equity Injection / Capital Contribution' to prevent mislabeling in anti-money-laundering screening. Transits through sanctioned or grey-list jurisdictions are prohibited under the correspondent banking policy.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Payments for titanium alloy powder, electron-beam melting equipment, spare parts, and freight are cleared via SWIFT MT103 for standard supplier remittances, with MT199/MT202 cover instructions for high-value invoices and SWIFT GPI for real-time tracking. Where contractual security is required, the Vanuatu International Company may instruct its tier-1 bank to issue an irrevocable Commercial Letter of Credit under UCP600 or a Standby Letter of Credit under ISP98. Each disbursement narrative must reference the invoice, the transport document, and the ISIC scope identifier, and must be accompanied by proforma invoices and/order confirmation to support the bank's transaction monitoring. Settlement of export-backed receivables may alternatively be discounted through a forfaiting or receivable purchase line with the licensed commercial bank, subject to cross-border credit and country-limit approvals.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards (USD/VUV) up to 12 months tenor, documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement executed with a licensed Vanuatu commercial bank, for hedging imported input costs and export settlement exposure

Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) on CNY, EUR, or AUD crosses through offshore banking centers, permissible because the VUV is not a deliverable currency in offshore forward markets, and used for protecting profit margins in third-country distributor sales

Cross-Currency Swaps (USD vs. EUR) for aligned funding of European hospital tenders and trade creditors, subject to the bank's derivatives authorization memo, board investment policy, and prudential limits on non-resident International Company treasury transactions

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based: Each International Company must file its Annual Return within 6 months after the anniversary date of incorporation (Section 106, International Companies Act [Cap 222]).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of USD 75 per month or part thereof for each overdue month; continued default for 3 months triggers formal late-filing notice; default for 6 months permits the Registrar to strike the company off the International Companies Register, after which assets may be forfeited to the Government of Vanuatu.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Office and Registered Agent Annual Declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based: Confirmation of registered office address and licensed registered agent must be included in the Annual Return filed within 6 months after each incorporation anniversary.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent and registered office in Vanuatu is a continuing offence punishable by a fine of up to USD 5,000 and individual officer fines of USD 100 per day; persistent breach is a ground for administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Business License / VFSC Licensed Entity Annual Compliance Statement (where applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year: If the International Company obtains a specific VFSC financial or business licence for the orthopedic implant export operations, the licence renewal application is due annually before 31 December, with a grace period to 31 January.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal attracts a penalty equal to 50% of the licence fee; operation without a valid licence is an offence subject to fines up to USD 10,000 and suspension of the company's International Company status.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit for a Vanuatu International Company; the International Companies Act [Cap 222] does not require audit or filing of financial statements. A voluntary independent audit may be required only by a financing counterparty, a due diligence mandate, or by VFSC if the company obtains a regulated financial services licence.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Voluntary financial statements, if prepared, are commonly presented under IFRS or an equivalent internationally recognized framework; Vanuatu International Companies are not subject to Vanuatu domestic GAAP or income tax filing requirements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company must maintain an internal Register of Members and Register of Directors reflecting all changes within 30 days of the transaction. The Annual Return filed with VFSC annually confirms the current registered shareholding and directorate; any transfer of shares is effective only upon entry in the Register of Members. Beneficial ownership confirmation is required in the Annual Return where a person holds or controls more than 10% of the issued shares, and must be updated promptly on any transfer.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book containing minutes of shareholder and director meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450 – USD 1,200 per annum depending on the VFSC-licensed registered agent and service provider
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not mandatory; where voluntary audit or a due diligence review is requested, estimated range USD 2,500 – USD 6,000 for a small international company with a single production and export objective

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu has no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, and no progressive income tax at the national level; the local Income Tax Act was repealed and income tax abolished, making the effective CIT headline rate zero for all legal entities, including International Companies.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: International Companies are statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu taxes (income, profit, capital, and stamp duty) on offshore-sourced activities under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; the VFSC may grant a written tax exemption certificate valid for 20 years; exports of titanium orthopedic implants are zero-rated for Vanuatu VAT purposes, and no VAT applies to pure offshore trading; nominal annual renewal fee applies but no effective income tax burden.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No CIT return exists in Vanuatu. The only mandatory annual compliance filing for an International Company is the VFSC Annual Return (International Companies Act [Cap. 222], s.116), submitted via the licensed registered agent or the VFSC e-portal (https://www.vfsc.vu).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of incorporation (no administrative extension; the annual return must be filed before the IC renewal fee is accepted).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact name shown on the Certificate of Incorporation, including the 'Limited' suffix.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must use the English registered name; translations are not accepted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unique identifier issued by the VFSC Registrar.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify against the original Certificate of Incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 3 — Registered agent and registered office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed agent in Port Vila and the physical address of the registered office in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The IC cannot self-represent; a VFSC-licensed agent is mandatory for non-resident owners.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Item 4 — Issued share capital and shareholders
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Classes of shares, total issued shares, and beneficial ownership (UBO) data held by the agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bearer shares are prohibited; offshore ultimate beneficial owners must be identified for AML/CFT records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, nationality, and residential address of each director and any secretary.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; nominee directorship is legal, but the agent must retain the identity of the controlling principal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that no business was conducted in Vanuatu and that activity was confined to offshore transactions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A positive local-trading declaration exposes the IC to the Business License Act [Cap. 194] and VAT Act [Cap. 323]; export-only manufacturing activity must be documented.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Untimely filing triggers a VFSC late-penalty tariff, rejection of the certificate of good standing, accruing daily surcharge until payment, and in persistent default, cancellation/strike-off of the IC from the register with potential forfeiture of assets; directors and the registered agent face fines under the International Companies Act.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Conditional CIT-adjacent filing: VAT Return Form VF 304 (Vanuatu Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 323]), filed electronically through the VAT online filing system administered by the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after the end of each VAT taxable period (quarter); export sales of titanium orthopedic implants are zero-rated.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Value of taxable supplies and the VAT charged at 12.5% domestic standard rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Zero-rated export invoices for offshore orthopedic implant sales must be supported by shipping evidence (waybills, customs declarations).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT paid on qualifying business inputs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident suppliers' invoices without VF 304 VAT registration details are not creditable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net position: output tax less input tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Export zero-rating normally yields a refund position; refund claims require full documentation of the export transaction.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late submission: statutory penalty plus monthly compounding surcharge on unpaid VAT; deliberate suppression of taxable turnover carries criminal enforcement and potential business license revocation.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax on outbound distributions from an International Company; dividends remitted through Swift/Wire or LC rails are paid gross.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable. Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement network and does not operate a tax residence certificate (TRC) procedure because there is no national income tax. When a foreign tax authority requires evidence of status, the non-resident shareholder must obtain from VFSC: (i) Certificate of Good Standing and (ii) certified extract of the register, together with a statutory declaration confirming the IC's exemption from Vanuatu tax; no reduced-rate treaty application process exists.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rate 0% for both royalty and interest; no treaty override structure. Cross-border payments for patent/process royalties (e.g., titanium surface-treatment technology) and intercompany debt interest leave the jurisdiction gross. Source-state anti-deferral and CFC rules may nonetheless reclassify the IC as a controlled foreign corporation in the shareholder's home jurisdiction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No local threshold; Vanuatu does not compel Local File, Master File, or Country-by-Country reporting. The VFSC only requires books and records sufficient to explain the IC's transactions (IC Act [Cap. 222], s.69); transfer pricing compliance is therefore a parent-jurisdiction obligation, not a VU statutory obligation.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP — Comparable Uncontrolled Price (OECD reference; not statutorily codified in VU law)
Resale Price Method (OECD reference; not statutorily codified in VU law)
Cost Plus Method (OECD reference; not statutorily codified in VU law)
TNMM — Transactional Net Margin Method (OECD reference; not statutorily codified in VU law)
Profit Split Method (OECD reference; not statutorily codified in VU law)
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No standalone ESR (Economic Substance Regulations) regime operates in Vanuatu. The applicable substance bar is structural: (i) licensed resident agent and registered office; (ii) prohibition of domestic business (offshore-only commerce); (iii) adequate transaction records; (iv) UBO disclosure under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 12 of 2014. A passive shell cannot lawfully manufacture, invoice, or bank within the jurisdiction; all production remains a foreign physical operation, with the IC serving purely as the legal counterparty.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / False Statements to the Registrar
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly filing a false annual return, misdeclaring the IC's offshore status, concealing local trading, or backdating incorporation documents to evade foreign tax obligations of the beneficial owner.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of up to VT 100,000 against the company plus daily penalty accrual; deregistration of the IC and revocation of the 20-year tax exemption certificate; criminal prosecution under the Penal Code [Cap. 135] where false declarations contain dishonesty.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations are personally indictable; courts may pierce the corporate veil, order restitution of any avoided duties/taxes, impose travel bans pending criminal trial, and enter custodial terms of imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a facade: tendering for Vanuatu government medical supply contracts, storing inventory in Vanuatu, employing local staff, or invoicing domestic hospitals while structurally claiming IC exempt status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines under the Business License Act [Cap. 194], including business license fees plus penalties of up to VT 3,000,000; the Registrar may strike off the IC and declare its contracts void; all local revenue streams are subject to retrospective VAT (12.5%) and community contributions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorized domestic trade are jointly and severally liable for unpaid business license fees, VAT, penalties, and third-party contractual claims; civil recovery orders and travel bans may be sought by the VFSC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT — UBO Obfuscation and Fraudulent Payment Flows
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing beneficial ownership, layering corruption or procurement-fraud proceeds through Swift/Wire and Letter of Credit transactions in the titanium implant supply chain, or failing to file suspicious transaction reports with the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the AML/CFT Act No. 12 of 2014: corporate fines up to VT 25,000,000, forfeiture of assets, VFSC license revocation, and deregistration; money laundering predicates carry imprisonment for involved individuals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face criminal prosecution for money laundering, possible imprisonment, personal asset freezes, travel bans, and extradition under Vanuatu's mutual legal assistance obligations; the corporate veil is disregarded for sham structures.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misusing a Vanuatu IC or VFSC-issued certificate to fraudulently claim non-residence in a high-tax source country for provision of orthopedic implants royalties, management fees, or sales commissions, thereby evading foreign withholding taxes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu imposes no local penalty, but the source country may levy back taxes, interest, and penalties; Vanuatu will withdraw the relevant certificate and may sanction the registered agent for issuing misleading letters; the IC is exposed to foreign CFC/GILTI-type attribution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Multilateral EOI requests can trigger personal examinations of directors; foreign tax authorities may impose personal liability, travel restrictions, and criminal restitution orders against controlling shareholders who engineered the abuse.
